title: Metadata: Can't remove trailing slash from canonical url when using metadata base.

labels.name: bug
labels.description: Issue was opened via the bug report template.

labels.name: linear: next
labels.description: Confirmed issue that is tracked by the Next.js team.

body: ### Verify canary release - [X] I verified that the issue exists in the latest Next.js canary release ### Provide environment information ```bash perating System: Platform: darwin Arch: arm64 Version: Darwin Kernel Version 22.2.0: Fri Nov 11 02:03:51 PST 2022; root:xnu-8792.61.2~4/RELEASE_ARM64_T6000 Binaries: Node: 18.16.0 npm: 9.5.1 Yarn: 1.22.17 pnpm: 8.6.9 Relevant Packages: next: 13.4.16-canary.1 eslint-config-next: 13.4.16 react: 18.2.0 react-dom: 18.2.0 typescript: 5.1.6 Next.js Config: output: N/A ``` ### Which area(s) of Next.js are affected? (leave empty if unsure) App Router, Metadata (metadata, generateMetadata, next/head) ### Link to the code that reproduces this issue or a replay of the bug https://github.com/lucashfreitas/nextjs-canonical-url-trailing-slash ### To Reproduce I'd like to have a canonical url for the base URL which does not have a trailing slash, but it's not possible to do it when using metadatabase. 1. Clone the repository. (https://github.com/lucashfreitas/nextjs-canonical-url-trailing-slash) 2. Run `next dev` 3. Note that the head `` to the head. ### Describe the Bug When using metadatabase and canonical URL is not possible to remove the trailing slash from the base URL. According to the documentation and example available here https://nextjs.org/docs/app/api-reference/functions/generate-metadata, if we set the canonical URL to `/` , nextjs would render only the metadataBase, but it's actually adding a trailing slash to the end. - when canonical is `/`: nextjs adds the trailing slash - when canonical is null or '': nextjs does not add a canonical link to the head. - when canonical URL is the base URL e.g `https://acme.com`: nextjs renders the baseUrl followed by a trailing slash. ### Expected Behavior I'd expect metadataBase to not add a trailing slash for the root/base URL. If my website is https://acme.com , I'd expect a `` without the trailing slash, but it does not seems possible when using metadatabase. (I verified that changing the trailing slash setting on `next.config.js` also doesn't work). According to the example mentioned here https://nextjs.org/docs/app/api-reference/functions/generate-metadata it should work but it doesn't seems to. ### Which browser are you using? (if relevant) _No response_ ### How are you deploying your application? (if relevant) _No response_ [NEXT-2424](https://linear.app/vercel/issue/NEXT-2424/metadata-cant-remove-trailing-slash-from-canonical-url-when-using)
